purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claim) software for Japan. It aggregates and calculates diagnosis-category-based point scores (shinryou kubun betsu tensuu shukei) for inpatient receipts, reading indexed RECE62/64/65/69 files and writing results including partial patient co-payment amounts and various medical billing detail fields.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

verdict.notes: The file is decoded as latin-1 but the Japanese comments are almost certainly EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The COPY statements reference external copybooks (.INC files) not shown in the truncated source. The COPY count shown as 0 in mechanical indicators is likely incorrect given the visible COPY statements — the tool may not have resolved them. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the well-known Japanese open-source ORCA project.
